title: Xiva O'zbekistonning birinchi UNESCO obidasi: 1990 yil

scenes.text: Xivaning devor bilan o'ralgan ichki shahri Ichan qal'a 1990 yilda Butunjahon merosi ro'yxatiga olingan.
Keyin Buxoro (1993), Shahrisabz (2000) va Samarqand (2001) qo'shilgan.

description: Xivadagi Ichan qal'a 1990 yilda (SSSR davrida) UNESCO Butunjahon merosi ro'yxatiga kiritilgan, bugungi O'zbekistondagi birinchi obida bo'lgan; keyin Buxoro tarixiy markazi 1993 yilda, Shahrisabz 2000 yilda, Samarqand 2001 yilda qo'shilgan.
source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/543 (Itchan Kala, inscribed 1990); https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/602 (Historic Centre of Bukhara, 1993); https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/603 (Samarkand - Crossroad of Cultures, 2001); https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/uz; https://www.worldatlas.com/articles/unesco-world-heritage-sites-in-uzbekistan.html (Shakhrisyabz 2000, Bukhara 1993). The 1990 inscription happened while Uzbekistan was part of the USSR. UNESCO pages themselves were not openable from this session; confirmed through search snippets.
